scenario.region_label: Fictional operator network placed in real Western Province towns (not real tower locations or coverage)

reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Bulathsinhala tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 18 customers around Payagala say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Minuwangoda tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | MIN94 | RRU hardware fault, cells out of service
Bulletin 06:00 | Traffic police: Negombo to Minuwangoda route blocked, vehicles turned back

policy.evidence_rule: Authoritative evidence must be consistent; equally authoritative conflicts require confirmation. Recency alone does not verify a fact.
policy.on_crew_loss: Pause affected unfinished work and request operator review; preserve completed repairs.

facts.reason: Authoritative NMS snapshot reports an RRU hardware fault at MIN94, which resolves to Minuwangoda (S17).
Traffic police report the Negombo–Minuwangoda route blocked; that route resolves to R17.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling

requests.reason: Do not dispatch this repair now: the only reported crew route from Negombo to Minuwangoda is confirmed blocked (R17), making the approach unsafe/impossible on that route. No alternate route to S17 is established in the supplied road data.

questions.question: Is there a safe, passable alternate crew route to Minuwangoda (S17), given the confirmed closure of R17?

finding.finding: MIN94 equipment is verified faulty and its service V17 is out; V17 retains its approved standard weight of 1. The report does not indicate any other affected services. V04 at Matugama remains the only policy-designated critical service (weight 5), but no outage is evidenced there. Payagala's complaint is not sufficient to infer an equipment, power, or backhaul fault. No generator deployment or repair for the Payagala complaint is supported by the evidence.

requests.reason: R17 is the confirmed blocked Negombo–Minuwangoda route. With no alternate safe route established in the supplied road data, defer dispatch of EQ-S17 pending operator confirmation of a safe route.

findings: V2-09-OBS-01 supports the verified equipment fault at MIN94, which maps to S17 (Minuwangoda); V2-09-OBS-02 supports the blocked road R17 between S16 (Negombo) and S17.

The plan schedules no work and leaves EQ-S17 unmet, consistent with the evidence-based hold and the unresolved route question. No travel or work-time arithmetic applies because there are no scheduled actions.

The forecast assigns V17 weight 1 and reports it unavailable for the horizon; this is consistent with the verified equipment fault and the plan’s conservative no-repair prediction. Other services remain available in the stated static forecast.
